summary_1line: Rishis announce Pandu’s death and the divine births of the Pandavas; the Kurus perform a grand funeral procession and cremation for Pandu and Madri.

image_candidates.scene_text: Ascetics with matted hair present the remains of Pandu and Madri before the Kuru court while the five young Pandavas stand beside Kunti.
A grand funeral procession carries Pandu and Madri on a flower-decked bier beneath a white royal umbrella as crowds weep and priests lead with sacred fire.
On the banks of the Ganga, the pyre burns while Kunti collapses in grief and Bhishma and Vidura stand sorrowfully amid the wailing crowd.
